items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: He said, you feel like playing something with me? I said, I don't care. I said, go get your guitar, and I'll go get my guitar, you know.

ctx.x: I could play a guitar. They had a fellow once, from where I was at, a place they called Grove State. He used to come there, they had an old bridge we used to settle on, you know, at night. He said, rap? I said, what? He said, you feel like playing something with me? I said, I don't care. I said, go get your guitar, and I'll go get my guitar, you know. How darn that fellow could play a guitar though. He, you know, make that guitar say most anything. The old mule coming at the, you know, at the gate and everything.…
You were speaking about the Johnny Dodds. Did you play your violin and he plays clarinet?
